title: Percolation of the contact process on the regular tree
summary: The contact process on the regular tree $\mathbb{T}_d$ when $d\geq 3$ has the two phase transitions of global and of local survival, found by Pemantle and Liggett at values $λ_1$ and $λ_2$. We start the system with every vertex infected and let it relax to what is known as the upper invariant infection. In this stationary state, $λ_p$ is the critical value beyond which the infected vertices can percolate through $\mathbb{T}_d$, and $λ_{p^\complement}$ is the parameter before which the healthy vertices can percolate. We find these are both distinct phase transitions…
